text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Summer! Ocean!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For some time now, Matikanetannhauser has been training harder than usual with her sights set on winning the Kikuka Sho. On one such day…

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: A million thanks!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Director?! Um, to what do I owe this sudden pleasure?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Director Akikawa has come to visit Matikanetannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: You should know that the average number of applications for our next open campus have increased by thirty percent following the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: The reasons are numerous, of course! However, I have no doubt that your efforts have played a major factor!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: In fact, I've seen many applicants state in their essays that your positive demeanor in the Japanese Derby gave them courage!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What? No, no, no, no! That's definitely got to be some kind of coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I mean, I've given it some thought, but… why me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Don't get me wrong. I'm very happy to hear it, of course! Really, really happy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But if you want an Umamusume who can guide others, what about Bourbon? Or Rice?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: There are so many people better suited to that kind of thing than I am…

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Oh, I see. I thought it would dawn on you as you raced!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: It seems you are still unaware of your potential!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I am?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Director Akikawa loudly clears her throat before facing Matikanetannhauser again.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: It isn't your race record that has drawn my attention!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: If anything, you're a perfectly ordinary Umamusume at a glance! But that's precisely what makes you unique!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Being ordinary makes me… unique?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Unaware are we? With just a single word, you inspire others to keep their heads up high!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Though… I could probably stand to learn a thing or two from you.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: It's because you're you they're so inspired!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I want you to believe in that power more than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, uh, um… Well! I guess I wouldn't say that I'm completely unaware…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm just not sure that I'm an inspiration to anyone… Though, I mean… I suppose…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Maybe I really do have the potential to inspire people…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The following day…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I've been all restless ever since the director said that stuff to me yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Is there some kind of training that can help me get rid of this feeling?
choice_data_list: Get buff by swimming a lap around an island!
Try running as much as you can to focus your mind.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Understood! Off I go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And just like that, Matikanetannhauser leaps into the ocean and swims far into the distance in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Focus my mind, huh?! Okay, I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Matikanetannhauser runs across the beach and far into the distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's rare for her to become flustered like this—she's usually so unperturbed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps Director Akikawa's expectations have stirred something within her.
